gmcm.section.pricing.name: Pricing
gmcm.section.pricing.tooltip: These settings control fixed contract prices for future contracts. They don't change a contract already saved or a shift already in progress.

gmcm.section.worker_behavior.tooltip: These settings control the worker's pacing, shift-end cutoff, and stuck-recovery timing on future shifts.
gmcm.pricing.tier_energy.name: {{tier}} energy

gmcm.pricing.outdoor_threshold.name: {{band}} outdoor threshold

gmcm.worker.walk_pixels_per_tick.name: Walk speed

gmcm.worker.action_animation_ms.name: Action animation time (ms)

gmcm.worker.entrance_hold_ticks.name: Entrance hold ticks
gmcm.worker.entrance_hold_ticks.tooltip: How long the worker pauses at the farm entrance so their arrival reads clearly.
gmcm.worker.work_on_holidays.name: Work on holidays
gmcm.worker.work_on_holidays.tooltip: When enabled, the farmhand works on festival and holiday days. Turn this off to keep the current skip-holidays behavior.
gmcm.worker.hard_cap_time.name: Hard cap time
gmcm.worker.hard_cap_time.tooltip: The Stardew HHMM time when the worker stops starting new work and begins wrap-up.
gmcm.worker.stuck_initial_wait.name: Initial stuck wait (minutes)
gmcm.worker.stuck_initial_wait.tooltip: How many in-game minutes the worker can make no progress before the first stuck-recovery step starts.
gmcm.worker.stuck_post_teleport_wait.too: How many in-game minutes the worker can remain stuck after a recovery teleport before escalating again.
